name: Access To Opulence
description: You carry an object that is symbolic of a connection to  wealth and which grants you +1 Bond with Monte dei Paschi as long as it is in your possession. Presenting this object will gain you an audience with any leadership figure in any Culture. When you gain an audience in this way, the first time you roll to influence that figure, you roll with advantage. Additionally, you may make purchases on credit, the terms of which are set by the DM. If you take this trait, you also have the Greed-touched trait.
